answer: Make trust a harbor chart no farm can forge: a newcomer must navigate a nebula of unrelated jobs, each leg ending at a vertex checkpoint where a different harbor-master verifies the work and signs the chart. The chart binds to one key, so a duplicate cannot copy another's route, and standing grows only as the chart fills with signed legs. Random drift audits then re-check charts each epoch, freezing any whose legs repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must fund a fresh chart, sail the full nebula, and pass fresh harbor-masters for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
